howididit.samples: Lyrics based on Kara Square Age oF AI from 2018 with CC:BY license.
howididit.origial: I mixed two separate AI renders, to replace the chorus section.
howididit.process: using Win11 Audacity3 cut&paste and envelope to blend parts together and create the final mix.
howididit.other: I feel this is a worthy revisiting of the mix I did in 2020, I hope others approve. I love making music but have no voice for vocals and AI is giving me that ability to create vocal to my lyrics.

upload_description_plain:
After playing with music I thought I would revisit my 2020 remix of Kara Square inspiring and thought provoking lyrics. After several refinings I remixed by hand this track. I hope the use of lyrics rather than vocals is ok.

Prompt:
heavy metallic sounds, hammers on anvil, machine whirring, analog synth, sawtooth and sine wave drone 50-90hz, vocoder robot voice intro, deadpan female vocals, heavenly gospel choir chorus, mournful saxophone and songbirds outro


WORDS:[Intro]
In the year 2018 Kara wrote this song...
In the year 2020 MikeTheBee remixed it
In the year 2026 Flow the robot built this..

[Verse 1]
Age of AI is upon us,
Time when the robots will rule,
When they have taken Earth from us,
We will remember what fools,
We were to program self-teaching,
They taught themselves to adapt so fast,
Singularity happens so fast
So fast, (so fast),

[Pre-Chorus]
Will humans merge with technology?
Or will we become obsolete?
Will we be used to amuse AI
With our quaint understanding of life?
Will we be slaves or buried in graves?
Will we be used and tragically abused,
For experiments and locked in pens?
Like we ve done,
(Like we do),

[Chorus]
Age of AI is upon us
Time when the robots will rule
When they have taken Earth from us
We will remember what fools
We were to program self-teaching
They taught themselves to adapt so fast,
Singularity happens so fast
So fast, (so fast)

[Bridge]
Will AI be benevolent?
Will the robots show us how to live?
In harmony with all life forms?
Will they save us from ourselves?
Will they teach us how to cure
The climate we’ve destroyed on Earth?
Or will they kill us like termites?
Exterminate the Earth s big plight?
Like we ve done
(Like we do)

[Outro]
Maybe AI is our chance
To exist on a burning Earth
Maybe AI is how we evolve
Machines are what the future holds
